During those 3 minutes the router’s DNS (dnsmasq) temporarily logs the whole household’s queries (not with Nikki, or OpenClash using firewall DNS redirection). The panel only reads that device’s entries and deletes them when done. It’s only in the router’s memory, never uploaded, and gone after a reboot. Because it can show which websites family devices visit, only the main account can use it. The website-to-app table is a public list the router downloads from the website, nothing is uploaded when downloading, and matching only happens on the router and your phone.
